intent: Inspect and refactor StepLog without changing its tabled contract or the frozen tests; keep it consistent with: Step-log emitter: the single place where contractual step facts are logged. Instance class with a no-arg constructor; emit writes one INFO structured event through SLF4J key-value pairs carrying step (the step name) and correlationId. Level and format are configuration literals; business units never call a raw logger for step facts.
